android.desc:
The ultimate tool for accurate square foot calculations and sharable instant cost estimation.

Whether you’re a professional contractor, real estate agent, or a homeowner planning a DIY renovation, SQFTY - Square Foot Calculator helps you measure areas quickly, accurately, and without hassle. Skip the complex math and messy notes—organize your projects room by room and get precise estimates in seconds.

🔑 Key Features

Multi-Room Projects
Add unlimited rooms and label them (Kitchen, Bedroom, Living Room, etc.) to keep your calculations organized.

Custom Shape Drawing
Beyond simple rectangles, you can now use the Drawing Tool to map out L-shapes, polygons, and complex layouts with precision.

Custom Spaces & Presets
Create your own space types like Home Office, Yoga Studio, Guest House, Swimming Pool, and more.

Instant Cost Estimation
Enter your price per square unit (e.g., flooring cost per sq. ft.) and get total project costs instantly.

Shareable Estimates
Share project links with clients or collaborators.

Advanced Unit Support
Work seamlessly with Feet & Inches, Meters, Centimeters, Millimeters, or Yards. Conversions are handled automatically.

Wall Size Calculation
A unique feature for detailed planning. Configure wall thickness and wall type for each side of a room to calculate accurate gross area.

Wastage & Buffer Planning
Add a buffer percentage (e.g., 10% for cuts, waste, or painting margins) to ensure you order enough material.

Save & Manage Projects
Save projects by name and revisit them anytime to update or review past estimates.

Import & Export Data
Export projects to CSV for Excel or Google Sheets, or import projects from other devices with ease.

Quick Calculator: For "one-off" calculations that can be promoted to a full project with a single tap.

👥 Who is this app for?

Anyone who needs a quick square foot calculation using length and width.

Flooring Installers – Estimate tile, laminate, or hardwood requirements with waste included.

Painters & Drywallers – Plan material quantities and costs efficiently.

Real Estate Agents – Verify property sizes and create room-by-room breakdowns.

Homeowners – Estimate budget for construction and renovations before speaking to contractors.

Builders & Contractors – Generate fast on-site estimates with cost breakdowns,  across rooms, floors or any surfaces like walls.
